namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0003 (a b c : Nat) (h1 : a ≤ b + c) (h2 : b ≤ a + c) : a + b ≤ 2 * c + 2 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0003 (a b c : Nat) (h1 : a ≤ b + c) (h2 : b ≤ a + c) : a + b ≤ 2 * c + 2 := by
  have h3 : a + b ≤ (b + c) + (a + c) := by
    rw [add_assoc, h2]
  have h4 : (b + c) + (a + c) = a + b + 2 * c := by
    simp [add_assoc]
  have h5 : a + b + 2 * c ≤ 2 * c + 2 := by
    linarith [h1, h3]
  exact h5

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0018 (a b c : ℝ) (h_a_pos : a > 0) (h_discr_neg : b^2 - 4 * a * c < 0) : ∀ x : ℝ, a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0018 (a b c : ℝ) (h_a_pos : a > 0) (h_discr_neg : b^2 - 4 * a * c < 0) : ∀ x : ℝ, a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0 := by
  intro x
  have h1 : a * x^2 + b * x + c = a * (x + b / (2 * a))^2 + c - b^2 / (4 * a) := by
    rw [mul_add, add_assoc, mul_div_cancel_left (ne_of_gt h_a_pos)]
  have h2 : a * (x + b / (2 * a))^2 ≥ 0 := by
    rw [h1]
    apply mul_nonneg
    exact h_a_pos
    apply sq_nonneg
  have h3 : c - b^2 / (4 * a) > 0 := by
    rw [h1]
    linarith [h_discr_neg, h_a_pos]
  exact add_pos h2 h3
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0018 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0018 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

theorem final_dev_0053 (a b c d : Nat) (h1 : a ∣ b) (h2 : c ∣ d) : a * c ∣ b * d := by

theorem final_dev_0060 {α β : Type*} {f : α → β} {X Y : Set α} (hX : X ⊆ A) (hY : Y ⊆ A) : f (X ∪ Y) ⊆ f X ∪ f Y := by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hb
  obtain haX : a ∈ X := by

  obtain haY : a ∈ Y := by

  obtain ⟨l, hk2⟩ := h2

  exact this

        induction' b with b ih
        · exact Nat.le_refl 1

import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0130 (l : List Nat) (h : l.length ≥ 2) : (l.drop 1).drop (l.length - 2).length ≥ 0 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0130 (l : List Nat) (h : l.length ≥ 2) : (l.drop 1).drop (l.length - 2).length ≥ 0 := by
  have hl1 : l.length > 1 := by
    from h
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne_of_gt h (Nat.ne_of_gt h)
  have hl2 : (l.drop 1).length = l.length - 1 := by
    rw [List.drop_length, hl1]
  have hl3 : (l.drop 1).drop (l.length - 2).length = (l.length - 1) - (l.length - 2) := by
    rw [hl2, List.drop_length]
  have hl4 : (l.length - 1) - (l.length - 2) = 1 := by
    ring
  exact Nat.zero_le hl4
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0130 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0130 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0130

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0130
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0130
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"

import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0193 (a b : ℤ) : a^4 - b^4 % 5 = 0 → a % 5 = b % 5 ∨ a % 5 = -b % 5 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0193 (a b : ℤ) : a^4 - b^4 % 5 = 0 → a % 5 = b % 5 ∨ a % 5 = -b % 5 := by
  intro h
  have h1 : a^4 ≡ b^4 [mod 5] := by
    rw [h]
  have h2 : a^4 - b^4 = 0 := by
    rw [h]
  have h3 : a^4 = b^4 := by
    rw [h2]
  have h4 : a^4 - b^4 = (a - b) * (a^3 + a^2 * b + a * b^2 + b^3) := by
    ring
  have h5 : (a - b) * (a^3 + a^2 * b + a * b^2 + b^3) % 5 = 0 := by
    rw [h4]
  have h6 : (a - b) % 5 = 0 ∨ (a^3 + a^2 * b + a * b^2 + b^3) % 5 = 0 := by
    omega
  have h7 : a % 5 = b % 5 ∨ a % 5 = -b % 5 := by
    by_cases h8 : a - b % 5 = 0
    · have h9 : a % 5 = b % 5 := by
        rw [h8]
        exact h9
    · have h10 : a^3 + a^2 * b + a * b^2 + b^3 % 5 = 0 := by
        rw [h5]
        exact h10
    · have h11 : a^3 + a^2 * b + a * b^2 + b^3 % 5 = 0 := by
        rw [h5]
        exact h11
    · have h12 : a % 5 = -b % 5 := by
        rw [h11]
        exact h12
    exact h7
  exact h7
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0193 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0193 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0193

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0193
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0193
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"

theorem final_dev_0203 {α : Type _} (A B : Set α) : card (A ∪ B) = card A + card B - card (A ∩ B) := by
  classical
  have h1 : card (A ∪ B) = card A + card (B \ A) := by

  intro h

      simp [List.length, List.cons]
    have h5 : 1 + List.length xs ≤ List.length xs + 1 := by

    have h3 : List.length (if x < 5 then x :: xs.filter (fun x => x < 5) else xs.filter (fun x => x < 5)) ≤ List.length (x :: xs) := by
      simp [h2]
    have h4 : List.length (x :: xs) = 1 + List.length xs := by
      simp [List.length, List.cons]
    have h5 : 1 + List.length xs ≤ List.length xs + 1 := by
      linarith
    exact h3.trans h5
end Nl2LeanCandidate

candidate.category: membership in images and inverse images of finite sets
candidate.domain: membership in images and inverse images of finite sets
candidate.expected_lean_statement: theorem final_dev_0228 {α β : Type*} {f : α → β} {X Y : Set α} (hX : X ⊆ α) (hY : Y ⊆ α) : f '' (X ∪ Y) ⊆ f '' X ∪ f '' Y
candidate.nl_statement: If \(A\) and \(B\) are finite sets, and \(f: A \to B\) is a function, then the image of the union of two subsets \(X\) and \(Y\) of \(A\) is a subset of the union of the images of \(X\) and \(Y\), i.e., \(f(X \cup Y) \subseteq f(X) \cup f(Y)\).
candidate.proof_block:
by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨a, haX_or_Y⟩ := Set.mem_union.1 hb
  obtain haX | haY := by

theorem final_dev_0228 {α β : Type*} {f : α → β} {X Y : Set α} (hX : X ⊆ α) (hY : Y ⊆ α) : f '' (X ∪ Y) ⊆ f '' X ∪ f '' Y := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

theorem final_dev_0228 {α β : Type*} {f : α → β} {X Y : Set α} (hX : X ⊆ α) (hY : Y ⊆ α) : f '' (X ∪ Y) ⊆ f '' X ∪ f '' Y := by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨a, haX_or_Y⟩ := Set.mem_union.1 hb
  obtain haX | haY := by
    cases haX_or_Y with a haX haY
    exact Set.mem_image_of_mem _ haX
    exact Set.mem_image_of_mem _ haY
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0228 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0228 := by

#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0228

run_cmd do

  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0228
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"

theorem final_dev_0229 (x y : ℝ) : sin (cos x + cos y) = sin (cos x) * cos (sin y) + cos (sin x) * sin (cos y) := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0229 (x y : ℝ) : sin (cos x + cos y) = sin (cos x) * cos (sin y) + cos (sin x) * sin (cos y) := by
  have h1 : cos x + cos y = cos x + cos y := by
    simp
  have h2 : sin (cos x + cos y) = sin (cos x + cos y) := by
    simp
  have h3 : sin (cos x + cos y) = sin (cos x) * cos (sin y) + cos (sin x) * sin (cos y) := by
    rw [sin_add, cos_add, sin_cos_add, cos_sin_add, sin_squared_add_cos_squared]
    ring
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0229 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0229 := by
